description: Live hotel prices for a place and dates. place can be a city, region, island, airport or landmark name anywhere in the world, a Quub destination slug (see list_destinations) or a Google place id. Returns up to limit hotels, cheapest first (or best rated): id, name, stars, guest rating (0 to 10) and review count, coordinates, photo, area or distance from the centre, the cheapest room with its total, board, refund rule and free cancellation deadline, its offer_id for prebook, and hotel_url / book_url pages a person can open. Prices are the total for the whole stay for one room, in the currency asked (EUR by default), as Nuitee, the booking partner and merchant of record, charges them, with the taxes Nuitee collects included. Taxes and fees paid at the property (often a city or tourist tax) are listed separately in taxes_at_property and are not in the total.

adults.description: Adults in the one room, 1 to 8. Default 2.

checkin.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD, 1 to 30 nights after check-in.

children.description: Ages of children in the room, if any.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the prices, default EUR.

nationality.description: Guest nationality, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (prices can depend on it). Default from the client's language, else NL.

place.description: Where: "Lisbon", "Kotor, Montenegro", "lisbon" (slug) or a Google place id.

sort.description: price (cheapest total first, default) or rating.

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
